title: Clo Digital Fashion Weekend 2024
description:
Check out our Digital Fashion Weekend event highlights! Discover the experiences shared by our visitors. From November 2-3rd, this event attracted hundreds of visitors eager to explore the CLO Ecosystem in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

Featuring #createwithclo works by local Vietnamese talent and highlighting our CLO Creator Collective including Stephy Fung (@stephyfung), Vesna Stawa (@orchidea3d), Patricia Nahorniac (@deadstockbloom), Greta Staude (@fashionx3d), Calvyn Justus (@calvynjustus) and Alfie Taylor (@akjt11). 

We're excited to host the next event! Share your city suggestions in the comments.

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

---

summary: ```markdown # Clo Digital Fashion Weekend 2024 ## Overview of Cloth3D and Its Impact on Fashion In this segment, we explore the integration of digital fashion tools, particularly focusing on Cloth3D, and its influence on the fashion industry. ## Contributions from Ho Chi Minh There are parts of the showcase where viewers can see works from various creators based in Ho Chi Minh. This highlights the diverse contributions to the digital fashion landscape from different regions. ## Personal Experience with Cloth3D I have been involved with Cloth3D for eight years, and I can attest to its significance in the fashion industry. One of my fashion shows is currently being displayed on the screen, showcasing the capabilities of this innovative platform. ## Collaboration with Factories The factories I partner with frequently utilize Cloth3D in their processes. This tool is not just an accessory but an integral part of our business model, enhancing our overall workflow. ## Benefits for Merchandisers I have had discussions with merchandisers who actively use Cloth3D. They have expressed that it significantly contributes to improved time management and efficiency in their operations. Furthermore, the communication between clients and our factories has become much more seamless due to the capabilities of Cloth3D. ## Conclusion Overall, the integration of Cloth3D in the fashion industry is not just a trend but a necessary evolution that enhances collaboration, efficiency, and creative expression. ```
